intent: A pale salt pan at night under dark basalt rims, crossed by the kings' tomb road: a dark causeway of pale broken columns, lesser graves and bone-white tombs, with the king's colossal ribcage as the landmark and a dusty ochre glow breathing out of the tombs.
requests: A pillar/column sculpt kind: the columns kind builds chunky cliff chunks, so a slender broken column had to be a single tall block.
An ossuary/skull prop kind, so the royal tomb and its landmark could read as a king rather than only a ribcage.
A run recipe for a processional colonnade of broken columns, so tomb-road arches and colonnades could line the road at run cost instead of prop cost.
